elements.text: 01 · 从一张工单看完整系统

elements.text:

Agent 负责构建和维护这个系统。两者的身份、工具和运行环境分开。

boards.name: 06 · Render 与 Daytona：让任务继续运行

elements.text: 06 · Render 与 Daytona：让任务继续运行
elements.originalText: 06 · Render 与 Daytona：让任务继续运行

elements.text:
Render worker 不依赖浏览器保持打开。任务状态存进 Supabase，进程重启后可以重新领取过期租约。Daytona 是
Code Agent 的隔离工作区，用于运行测试和复现，不承担持久业务队列。

customData.code:
# Budget reservation before calling a model.
from threading import Lock
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
lock = Lock()
remaining = 100
def reserve(amount):
    global remaining
    with lock:
        if remaining < amount: return False
        remaining -= amount
        return True
with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as pool:
    result = list(pool.map(reserve, [60, 60]))
assert result.count(True) == 1
assert remaining == 40
print("PASS: budget cannot be overspent", result)
